Overview

Dark Mage (Fallen Star) is a Secret Limited unit. He is only obtainable by evolving Dark Mage

Evolving

Dark Mage (Fallen Star) can be evolved from Dark Mage with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Dark Mage
x1 Black Spear
x12 Star Fruit
x3 Star Fruit (Blue)
x5 Star Fruit (Red)
x4 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Dark Mage (Fallen Star)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

This unit is obtained by completing the Frozen Abyss event and getting a Fallen Star portal.

The chance of getting this portal is less than 1%.

Unit does 2/3rd of his dmg than it is displayed to from upgrade 0-1. (Fixed as of Update 19 Assassin Park Update)


  1. ↑ Takedowns refer to kills or assists
